verdict.rationale: Postman's collaboration docs say roles and permissions can be assigned to team members at the team, workspace, and element levels. Element-level control covers access to individual APIs and collections. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of view vs. edit role definitions for APIs and collections, details on how role assignment is administered, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can control who can view or edit APIs and collections with roles and permissions

citations.quote: You can define the roles and permissions assigned to team members at the team, workspace, and element levels.
